messages:
Sasha: ok real talk — thermostat wars again? room is a sauna for me rn :sweat_smile:
Ryan: same, I had to open a window at 2pm. brought three fans :fan:
Janet: can we please not reopen this debate every week lol. People Ops suggested a 'thermo truce' idea earlier — remember?
Taylor: I proposed a tiny rota and a baseline temp. Happy to run a quick poll.
sasha: poll please. also I veto anything below 70F. my fingers go numb. :cold_face:
ryan: I veto above 74F. I am a delicate houseplant. :seedling:
Taylor: ok options: A) 72F Mon-Fri 9-6, B) 71F with 2pm cooldown window, C) rotating "Thermo-Keeper" who can change by +/-1 for emergencies. react with :one: :two: :three: to vote
facilities-bot: FYI the thermostat can be scheduled by zone but needs a facilities ticket for recurring rules. filing ticket... #FAC-1042
Janet: love the "Thermo-Keeper" idea tbh. gives people agency w/out full chaos.
Ryan: :one: voted for 72F. also can we add a summer policy to bump a degree up in June-Aug?
Sasha: :three: for keeper. also bring back the legendary office blanket stash?
Taylor: I'll draft a short policy and ping Facilities & People Ops. rough draft in thread now:
Taylor: ```
Thermo Truce (pilot 4 weeks):
- Baseline: 72F Mon-Fri 09:00-18:00
- Thermo-Keeper rota (weekly) can adjust by +/-1F for that week
- Emergency override: Facilities on call
- Summer buffer: +1F from Jun 1 - Aug 31
```
Janet: looks good. :thumbsup:
facilities-bot: Ticket FAC-1042 updated: "Propose Thermo Truce schedule + zone enablement" — assigned to Facilities Team. ETA 2 business days.
Ryan: if Facilities can do zone schedule that would be ideal. otherwise the rota will at least reduce friction.
Sasha: thanks everyone. if this passes I will contribute two throw blankets to the stash. :blanket: :heart:
Taylor: declaring initiative: "The Great Thermo Truce". will loop in People Ops and post final poll later today. :tada:
